background_image_description: Cafe interior scene shot at an angle: a textured matte gray wall fills the upper half; in the lower half a wooden table with warm medium-brown grain sits diagonally from bottom left to mid-right. On the table, a light bamboo tray holds a dark glass of coffee with crema, a folded white napkin, and polished silverware (fork and spoon). Behind the tray is an open dark-gray laptop with the keyboard visible and the lid tilted back. At far right, a white plate with a flaky pastry partly enters the frame. A black chair with a curved backrest is at the left edge. Soft natural lighting from the right creates gentle shadows.
